subject: Who decides when the Ridge Line reopens in spring

proposals.title: The engineer who signs the reopening
proposals.question: Who decides when the Ridge Line reopens, and on what check?
proposals.tells: Follow the one signature that opens the route: the drainage inspection, then the sign-off.
proposals.cannotClaim: That the sign-off date can be predicted a year ahead; the sources give past dates only.
proposals.criterion: The reader can name who signs the reopening and the check behind it; the sources do not show how the date is chosen from one year to the next.
proposals.reason: Two sources name the sign-off and its check; the other readings rest on one source each.

proposals.title: Ten springs, ten dates
proposals.question: How have the reopening dates moved since 2016?
proposals.tells: Line up the logged reopening dates and show the spread without explaining any single year.
proposals.reader: Riders who want to know what to expect
proposals.cannotClaim: Why any single year was earlier or later; the log gives dates, not causes.
proposals.criterion: The reader can order the logged dates and tell a documented date from a guess; the sources do not explain the differences.
proposals.reason: The log is solid for dates but silent on causes, so the story stays descriptive.

proposals.title: Does the snow decide?
proposals.question: Is the route reopened when the snow melts?
proposals.tells: Take the rider belief, set it against the maintenance plan and say what each supports.
proposals.reader: Riders who repeat the snow explanation
proposals.cannotClaim: That snow plays no role at all; the plan names drainage as the check, it does not exclude snow.
proposals.criterion: The reader can restate the snow belief and the documented check; the sources do not settle whether snow ever delays the sign-off.
proposals.reason: The belief is only attested by one forum thread, so the correction needs care.

vigilance: The reopening log stops at 2025; a 2026 date is not documented.
The forum thread is a rider's account, not an official source.
The closure carousel already covers the October closure; do not repeat it.
beforeWriting: Open the council minutes and confirm the sign-off wording.
Find out whether the logged 2020 date was a delay or a plan.
basisReason: No comparable spring piece has been published yet.
